rationale.consistency: License headers, module registration, caddyfile.go split and standard import match siblings; but handler JSON fields use time.Duration not caddy.Duration, ServeHTTP has a value receiver, and struct fields lack doc comments.
rationale.edge_cases: Rate-only config (timeout 0, MinRate>0) yields deadline==Start on first call and fails immediately; hard deadline anchored at handler start, not connection start; no 1-minute server default applied in Provision.
rationale.scope: Covers all requested surfaces, but adds unrequested positional args to the directive and rate args to server timeouts; server-level 1m default is only honored when the Caddyfile subdirective omits its value.
rationale.readability: Clear structure and names; calculate() is easy to follow; minor dead code (io.EOF branch after io.Copy) and repeated chunk-size defaulting.
rationale.robustness: No panics, nil-body and nil-Ctrl guards, ErrNotSupported tolerated; but instant-failure bug for rate-only configs and double wrapping when server and route both enable it.
rationale.maintainability: parseRate is copy-pasted into two packages and chunk-size defaulting is duplicated; exported mutable IdleDeadline fields leak internals; otherwise shared reader/writer reused cleanly by both layers.
